g: Place 以前 and 以後 on the Timeline

s: 我昨天跟朋友說了很多話，我們都很開心。
Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou shuō le hěn duō huà, wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
Yesterday I said a lot to my friend, and we were both very happy.
當別人遇到不愉快的事時，應該避免說些刺激他的話。
Dāng biérén yùdào bù yúkuài de shì shí, yīnggāi bìmiǎn shuō xiē cìjī tā de huà.
When others encounter unpleasant things, one should avoid saying things that irritate them.
